title: Fanout conditions for the circuit DAG translation
statement: For every Boolean circuit $c$ on $n$ variables, let $G$ be the list of gates in its directed acyclic graph translation, let $r$ be its output index, and let $F(v)$ count the gates in $G$ whose argument list contains the index $v$. Every index $v$ with $n\le v<n+|G|$ has $F(v)=0$, every $v\ge n$ has $F(v)\le1$, and if $r\ge n$ then $F(r)=0$. Also, either $r<n$ or $n+|G|\le r$, and every index $v$ with $n+|G|\le v<n+|G|+|G|$ and $v\ne r$ has $F(v)=1$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a Boolean circuit on $n$ variables
The initial gate list in the fanout specification is empty
For each $v$ with $n\le v<n+|G|$, its fanout in $G$ is $0$
For each $v\ge n$, its fanout in $G$ is at most $1$
If $r\ge n$, the output index has fanout $0$
For each $v$ with $n+|G|\le v<n+|G|+|G|$ and $v\ne r$, its fanout in $G$ is $1$
